تمكن مهندس الذكاء الاصطناعي كارتر تشيرش، بمساعدة GPT-6 Astra، من فك شفرة رسالة عسكرية فرنسية أُرسلت عام 1809 إلى المارشال أوغست دو مارمونت، أحد قادة نابليون، وظلت غير مفهومة لمدة 217 عامًا. واستطاع النموذج تحليل صورة أرشيفية للرسالة، ونسخ رموزها ثم مطابقة الأنماط للوصول إلى نص يكشف معلومات عن مواقع وتحركات القوات الفرنسية والنمساوية قبل اندلاع الحرب. وقد راجع باحث في علم الشفرات التاريخية الحل، وصُنفت الرسالة لاحقًا ضمن الشفرات التي تم حلها، مع بقاء بعض الرموز محل نقاش.

If you want fire cider ready for the colder months, now is the time to make it.

I fill a jar with fresh horseradish, ginger, turmeric, garlic, onion, jalapeños, lemon, orange, rosemary and thyme, plus cinnamon, cloves and black pepper, then cover everything with raw apple cider vinegar and let it infuse for about 4 weeks.

The smell alone is incredible. It becomes spicy, tangy, warming and SO flavorful. Once it’s ready, strain it and add honey to taste.

Definitely one of those recipes that takes a little patience but is so satisfying to have ready for the colder months. ❤️

What should I freeze dry next? 🍓 Freeze dried strawberry chips. Strawberries hold so much water that they take far longer than any other fruit. 80 hours to pull every single bit of moisture out. What you’re left with tastes more like strawberry than a fresh strawberry does. Intensely flavoured, completely crispy. Fresh or frozen both work. Frozen strawberries are usually frozen right at the source, so any time of year is fine. Seal the bag the moment you’re done. Belén Soto: “Siempre fue una amistad de estar muy disponible la una para la otra. Nos hemos dado el tiempo de ocuparnos de la relación y darnos señales de vida”.

In 1967, an American spy satellite photographed something on the Caspian shore that nobody could explain.

It was the KM, a Soviet test craft about 92 meters long that flew a few meters above the water on ground effect. The Americans called it the Caspian Sea Monster and reportedly took 20 years to understand it. At 544 tons it was the heaviest aircraft in the world until 1988, built to move military cargo over water at plane speed.

Pilot error sank it in 1980. The Lun-class built on its design stayed in service until the late 1990s.

Too low for a plane, too fast for a ship, and too heavy to pull out of the sea.

Every September, the UK opens a portal to 1960s.

Goodwood Motor Circuit opened in 1948, built on the perimeter road of an old RAF airfield by Freddie March, the Duke of Richmond. Competitive racing stopped there in 1966, when the cars got too fast for the track and the family chose to stop rather than change the circuit.

The track itself never really closed, it kept going as a test and track-day venue for decades. But in 1998, the Duke’s grandson brought racing back with the Revival, on one condition: only cars, motorcycles, and dress from 1948 to 1966 allowed.

They take that rule seriously. Over 10,000 period costumes across 800 staff and performers. Vintage Land Rovers doing tow-truck duty. More than 30 corners of the circuit dressed down to the original signage.

And then there’s the crowd: over 150,000 people across three days, most of them in period dress simply because they want to be.

It is easy to forget what year it actually is while you’re there. Worth seeing at least once.

“Good rally drivers have dead flies on their windows.” Walter Röhrl said that. Then he drove something that made him afraid for his life.

From 1982 to 1986, the FIA handed rally manufacturers almost a blank rulebook. Build 200 road cars to homologate, and that was it - no design limits, no power caps. Audi, Lancia, Peugeot, and Ford built 450 to 600 horsepower into frames under 1,000 kilograms. By 1986, these cars were doing 0-60 in under three seconds on gravel.

In the same year, Henri Toivonen lapped the Estoril circuit in his Lancia Delta S4 during the Portuguese rally. His time reportedly would have qualified him sixth on that season’s Formula One grid. A rally car was matching Grand Prix speeds on a forest stage surrounded by spectators.

Röhrl was testing Audi’s Sport Quattro S1 E2 in Greece when his speed between two hairpins jumped from just over 100 mph to 130. The two-time world champion - the same man who joked about dead flies - pulled in and told his team he was afraid for his life.

By May 1986, it was too late. In Portugal, Joaquím Santos lost control of his Ford RS200 and ploughed into a crowd, killing three spectators. Weeks later, Toivonen and co-driver Sergio Cresto died when their Delta S4 left the road at the Tour de Corse and caught fire. The FIA banned Group B immediately. From 1987, rally cars were capped at 300 horsepower.

The sport never built anything that fast again. A works Lancia Delta S4, once driven by Toivonen, sold at auction in London for $2.2 million in 2022.

The drivers had stopped joking. Rallying learned to be afraid.

No house. No ring. No kids. Yet Gen Z is spending more on wellness than ever.

The median age at first marriage is now 30.2 for men and 28.6 for women, according to the US Census Bureau, up nearly a decade since 1960. Homeownership under 35 has fallen from a 2004 peak of 43% to about 37% today, and close to a third of 18-to-34-year-olds now live with their parents.

Buying a house in your 20s has become the exception, not the norm. But the money hasn’t disappeared. It’s just moved. 💪

Real spending on gyms and sports clubs has hit its highest level in over two decades. McKinsey’s Future of Wellness report found Gen Z and millennials - just 36% of US adults - now drive more than 41% of the country’s annual wellness spend.

When you’re stuck in a tiny rental or still living at home, you need somewhere else to go. A third space.

That’s a big part of why boutique fitness and wellness are booming right now. This generation is trading down payments for premium gym memberships, social pedal clubs, and high-end recovery saunas. Health has officially become the new wealth status symbol.

For fitness businesses, that changes the brief. You’re not selling a 45-minute class anymore. You’re competing to be this generation’s primary social hub.

Still no house. Still no ring. But they’ve never been in better shape.

I want to tell you guys a little bit about @kulturecity.  Haley and I were thrilled to be invited to this wonderful organization’s annual #KultureBall and support the incredible work it does to provide access and inclusion for people with invisible disabilities.

1 in 4 individuals in the US has a sensory processing need.  Since its founding, KultureCity has provided live event spaces, museums, stadiums, and other public spaces and businesses the training and resources to turn their venue into a place where everyone can feel included.  This includes specialized kits for individuals with autism, PTSD, dementia and more to be used in case they need assistance while visiting these venues.  KultureCity also provides portable sensory rooms in case people with these invisible disabilities need a quick break to reset while at an event and then re-join the fun.

As an actor who began his career in the theater, I believe the joy of experiencing a live performance is something everyone should be included in and have access to.  It can change a life, the same way it changed mine.

In addition to the amazing work KultureCity does making spaces and businesses accessible to everyone, they also provide important sensory inclusive training to first responders.  This work is vital to helping our first responders serve all citizens with dignity regardless of their sensory needs, mental health challenges or invisible disabilities.

I’m excited to work with KultureCity to help bring access to even more spaces in Los Angeles.

🇺🇸Today, on Tree Day, I touch a Samaúma in the Amazon, and I still don’t have the words to express everything I’ve learned from these beings.

Trees were here long before us. They carry wisdom our bodies have never known and, in silence, work every single day to make our existence on Earth possible.

After everything I’ve experienced in the Amazon, I feel that my understanding of the power of nature has shifted entirely.

As an artist, I feel called.

Called to embrace narratives that restore awareness to our relationship with the Earth.

After all, we’ve spent so long believing that we are the species that came here to teach that we’ve forgotten to ask what the beings who came before us are here to teach us.

Plants are teachers.

And trees are the great, true elders of this planet. 🌳💗

But where do you get your protein? If I had a freaking nickel for every time I've been asked that.... 
Getting enough protein is more important than it's ever been as I recover from surgery and make sure my body has the proper fuel to heal. It's honestly easy!!! There are so many ways to get your clean, lean protein.

Chickpeas are one of the oldest cultivated crops on earth, grown for around 10,000 years. Hummus combines them with tahini, which is made from sesame seeds and adds extra protein, healthy fats, and calcium.

Tofu is a complete protein, meaning it contains all nine essential amino acids your body can’t make on its own. When it’s made with calcium sulfate (check the label), it’s also one of the best plant sources of calcium out there.

Hemp seeds are one of the few plant foods that are a complete protein, with about 10 grams in just three tablespoons. Large Harvard studies following over 100,000 people found that regular nut eaters had a lower risk of heart disease. I sprinkle them on basically everything.

Vegetables add up! A cup of cooked green peas has about 8 grams of protein, and spinach, broccoli, and Brussels sprouts each bring a few grams per cup. When you eat a lot of plants, it all counts.

Pumfu is a tofu alternative made from pumpkin seeds, so it’s completely soy free. Pumpkin seeds are naturally loaded with protein, magnesium, and zinc, and it crumbles perfectly into a salad.

Beans are a daily staple in every one of the world’s Blue Zones, the regions where people live the longest. A cooked cup of black beans gives you about 15 grams of protein plus a huge dose of fiber, which most Americans don’t get nearly enough of. Also- fun fact: peanuts aren’t nuts at all, they’re legumes!

A 2015 study found that pea protein supported muscle growth just as well as whey protein in people doing resistance training. One scoop in my smoothie gives me around 20 grams, and it tastes like dessert.

Tempeh comes from Indonesia and is made by fermenting whole soybeans, which makes it easier to digest. It packs around 20 grams of protein per 100 grams, making it one of the most protein dense plant foods you can buy.

I recently had surgery (I’m okay and I’ll share more soon)! Mostly I just want to say if you're going through health stuff- I see you. I know it feels lonely & scary but you're not alone! I also really wanted to share all the beautiful flowers my friends & fam sent because they brought me so much joy. 

A few life lessons that I'll carry forward... 

1. Extend grace to friends and coworkers who miss your texts and emails. You never know what someone is going through!
2. GIRLS!! Do NOT skip your regular checkups and routine Pap smears! Even if you feel well and have no symptoms, these tests are screeners designed to catch things early. And they do!
3. Keep showing up for your people, because you never know when you’ll need them to show up for you. My friends and family who visited during recovery and sent flowers, food, and encouraging messages truly got me through the whole ordeal.
4. It’s never as bad as you think it’s going to be. I had SO MUCH anxiety about the surgery itself, especially going under and waking up from anesthesia. It wasn’t nearly as scary as I expected. The surgical team was kind and reassuring and made sure I was comfortable!
5. You’re never too old to need your mama. My mom and aunt took me to the surgery, and when I woke up, my mom was right there holding my hand. There’s no comfort like a mama’s love, and I’m so lucky to have the best mama, who flew across the country to take care of Zoe and me.
6. Don’t feel bad about prioritizing your health. Since discovering the issues that led to my surgery, I’ve given up alcohol. I’ve felt pressure to drink in some social situations, but my body knew it needed a break. I’m so happy I listened to my body and honored my intuition.

Easy vegetarian lasagna 🍅

I’m loving making simple and delicious meals lately, and this lasagna is perfect for the whole family as the weather starts to cool down too. Make sure to save this recipe to enjoy this Winter, and follow for weekly recipes @elsas_wholesomelife ✨

Ingredients:
Vegetarian mince: - 1 tbsp olive oil - 1 brown onion, diced - 3 garlic cloves, minced - 400g plant based mince - 2 tsp mixed dried herbs - 100ml red wine - 500g sugo tomato pasta sauce - salt and pepper, to taste Bechamel sauce: - 2 cups soy milk - 1/3 cup butter - 1/4 cup flour - 1 cup tasty cheese - salt and pepper, to taste To assemble: - 375g fresh lasagna sheets - fresh spinach, as desired - fresh basil, as desired  Method: 1. Preheat the oven to 180°C fan-forced and prepare a rectangle baking dish 2. Place a large pot over the stove on medium-high heat. Add olive oil, brown onion and garlic and fry for 2 minutes 3. Add plant-based mince and dried herbs and continue frying for a further 2-3 minutes 4. Add red wine, sugo sauce and salt and pepper, to taste. Prepare your lasagna by layering as desired - I personally went in the following order: lasagna sheet, tomato mince mixture, lasagna sheet, béchamel sauce, fresh spinach, lasagna sheet, tomato mince mixture, fresh basil, lasagna sheet, béchamel sauce, fresh basil 8. Spinach and ricotta shells 😋

This recipe is one of my favourite pasta dishes, so easy to make and a great one for entertaining too 🤌🏼

Ingredients: - 250g ricotta - 3 tbsp lemon juice - 100g chopped spinach - 1 tbsp minced garlic - 1 tsp salt - cracked pepper, to taste - 700g passata - handful of fresh basil leaves - 12 pasta shells - sprinkle of parmesan - 1 tbsp pine nuts

Method:
1. Preheat the oven to 180°C fan-forced and place a large pot of water to boil over the stove, on high heat.
2. Once water is boiled, add the pasta shells to the pot. Cook as per packet instructions, ensuring not to overcook. Then, drain and rinse with cold water.
3. Add passata, fresh basil leaves, 1/2 tsp salt and pepper to a 30cm x 20cm baking dish and mix, spreading evenly.
4. Add ricotta, lemon, spinach, garlic, 1/2 tsp salt and pepper to a bowl and mix well to combine.
5. One-by-one, spoon approx 2 tbsp of the ricotta mixture into each shell and place into the baking dish. Repeat until shells and ricotta mixture are all used up.
6. Sprinkle with parmesan and pine nuts, and place into the oven to bake for 15-20 minutes, or until pine nuts and pasta shells begin to brown.
7. Serve hot & enjoy!

Creamy tomato burrata pasta 🍅

This pasta dish is such a great, simple meal for the Summertime! It’s super easy to make and absolutely delicious, hope you enjoy 😋

(Serves two)

Ingredients: - 2 tbsp butter - 1 garlic clove, minced - 1 whole chilli, diced - 250g cherry tomatoes - 2 tbsp tomato paste - 1 cup thickened cream - 250g pasta, cooked al dente - 150g burrata - fresh basil leaves, to serve - salt and pepper, to taste

Method: 1. Cook your pasta and prepare garlic and chilli 2. Place a large frying pan over medium-high heat on the stove, add butter and melt 3. Add garlic, chilli and cherry tomatoes and fry for 3-4 minutes 4. Add tomato paste, salt and pepper and continue frying for a further 3 minutes 5. Add thickened cream and reduce heat to low-medium. Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, for a further 6-7 minutes or until the cherry tomatoes begin to break apart easily 6. Add pre-cooked pasta and mix well with the sauce 7. Tear burrata into chunks and pick fresh basil leaves. Add to the pasta 8. Enjoy!

Ingredients: - 1 tbsp cooking oil of choice - 1 brown onion, cut into chunky pieces - 1 carrot, cut in half lengthways and then sliced - 250g green beans - 1 head of broccoli, cut into florets - 750ml water - 1 Japanese curry mix packet (92g) - 2 vegan schnitzels, cooked as per packet instructions - Cooked white rice, to serve - Sesame seeds, to serve  Method: 1. Heat a large frying pan or wok over medium-high heat, add the oil 2. Add onion and fry for 2-3 minutes, before adding carrot and frying for a further 2-3 minutes 3. This delicious winter minestrone recipe is from the slow cooker section of my 3rd cookbook, Simple Vegan Kitchen 🍅

It is super hearty and warming, and filled with loads of nutritious veggies! Save this recipe so you can make it this winter ☺️

Ingredients: - 1 tbsp olive oil - 2 celery stalks, sliced - 1 leek, white part only, halved lengthways and sliced - 1 carrot, quartered and sliced - 1 French shallot, finely chopped - 3 garlic cloves, crushed - 280g potatoes, cut into 1cm pieces - 3 bay leaves - 2 tsp dried Italian herbs - 400g can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained - 1.5 litres veggie stock - 2 x 400g cans crushed tomatoes - 1/4 tsp sea salt - freshly ground pepper to taste, plus extra to serve - 100g pasta shells - thick-cut bread, to serve (optional)  Method: 1. Turn your slow cooker to the saute setting 2. Add the olive oil and, once it’s hot, add the celery, leek, carrot, shallot and garlic and saute for 2-3 minutes, until the vegetables have softened 3. Switch the slow cooker to high, add the remaining ingredients except the pasta and mix lightly, then cover with the lid and cook for 3 hours 4. Add the pasta shells to the slow cooker and stir them through. Cover with the lid and continue to cook on high for another hour or until the pasta shells are cooked through 5. Serve hot, with a good sprinkling of freshly ground black pepper and some thick-cut bread on the side, if desired

Enjoy!

Many parents struggle with their adult children’s life choices, feeling fear about their future. We watch them grow from little, helpless babes into adults who can make amazing or devastating decisions.

But, turning your child over to God means trusting His love and timing, rather than trying to control their decisions. 

We have to orient our prayers in love, focusing on God’s transformation rather than worry about our kid's actions. We can turn to scripture to guide how we pray for our children, letting the Word shape our perspective and anchoring our trust in God.

Ultimately, God works in ways we may not understand, and he provides grace to help both parents and children through tough times.

Who Was Amazing Grace Lyricist John Newton?
Born into a captain’s family who traded at the East India Company, John Newton (July 24, 1725 – December 21, 1807) embarked on sea voyages at the young age of 11. He soon entered the prosperous slave trade until he nearly died on a voyage that would change his life forever. He proclaimed, “Only God’s amazing grace could and would take a rude, profane, slave-trading sailor and transform him into a child of God.” This would influence his famed hymn Amazing Grace, in which he declared he was once blind but now could see.

⬇️ After more than two decades away from the regular Quality Street assortment, the cult-favourite Coffee Crème is officially back on supermarket shelves. ☕🍫⁠
⁠
Fans no longer need to rummage through an entire tin hoping to find one. Asda is selling a dedicated 281g sharing bag filled exclusively with coffee-flavoured fondant centres coated in rich dark chocolate. It is currently listed online for £4.50, although prices and availability may differ between stores. 🛒⁠
⁠
Nostalgic shoppers are understandably excited. One declared: “Coffee cream lovers, now is our time!” while another promised: “If this is true I’ll be coming home with a trolley full!” 😂⁠
⁠
Its comeback should come as no surprise. When Nestlé asked people which discontinued Quality Street sweet they most wanted back in 2021, Coffee Crème secured 8,146 of the 20,800 votes—around 39% of the total. It comfortably defeated the Almond Octagon, Fruits of the Forest Crème, Jaffa Toffee and Vanilla Octagon. Nestlé also revealed that it received more enquiries about Coffee Crème than any other discontinued variety. 🗳️⁠
⁠
Quality Street’s Emily Grimbley said: “Although the coffee crème hasn't featured in the mix since the turn of the millennium, it’s clear that it still holds a special place in the nation’s heart.” ❤️⁠
⁠
The sweet previously enjoyed limited festive returns through John Lewis and Waitrose in 2023 and 2024, but these standalone supermarket bags make it considerably easier for devoted fans to stock up—and perhaps hide a few from the family. 🎄⁠
⁠

FRANCISCO GOMES NETO DEFENDE SIMPLICIDADE PARA LIDERAR A EMBRAER

Engenheiro de formação e CEO da Embraer, Francisco Gomes Neto construiu sua trajetória entre fábricas, máquinas e planilhas. Mas, ao falar de liderança, volta sempre ao mesmo ponto: pessoas.

À frente da companhia desde 2019, ele atravessou o fim do acordo com a Boeing e, logo depois, o impacto da pandemia sobre a aviação. A resposta foi concentrar a empresa no essencial: fortalecer o caixa, ganhar eficiência, preservar a inovação e manter os times alinhados.

A Embraer chega a 2026 em um novo patamar. No segundo trimestre, registrou receita recorde de R$ 11,34 bilhões, lucro líquido ajustado de R$ 1,11 bilhão e carteira de pedidos de US$ 34,5 bilhões. Para Gomes Neto, o desafio agora é transformar esse volume em receita, caixa e rentabilidade sem sacrificar margens, qualidade ou prazos.

"EU ESTOU COMENDO SAUDADE": A HISTÓRIA DE CHAIM ZAHER

Décadas depois de deixar o Líbano, o fundador do Grupo SEB voltou a Beirute em busca de uma lanchonete da infância. Aos sete anos, vendia chicletes no centro da cidade e sonhava em comprar o sanduíche que via os outros comerem. Ao voltar, décadas depois, pediu cinco de uma vez: "Eu estou comendo saudade".

Zaher chegou ao Brasil em 1960, ainda criança, fugindo dos efeitos da guerra no Líbano. A família recomeçou do zero em Araçatuba, no interior de São Paulo — o pai, que era mascate, perdeu tudo ao se aventurar no ramo alimentício.

A entrada na educação foi quase acidental: começou como bedel e porteiro em um cursinho pré-vestibular. Para conseguir representar a marca Objetivo na região, esperou o diretor esvaziar a sala, trancou-se no prédio e passou a noite lá dentro até conseguir a conversa na manhã seguinte.

"O segredo é nunca fazer igual aos outros, e nunca bater de frente com o líder. Você entra por onde ele não está, com humildade, respeitando quem já está lá", resume Zaher.

Mais de seis décadas depois, está à frente do Grupo SEB, que reúne marcas como Maple Bear, Concept, Pueri Domus e Poliedro, além de 12,16% da Yduqs, dona de Estácio e Ibmec.

DE PISTA DE BOLICHE A US$ 800 MILHÕES

Joe Strada começou a trabalhar ainda jovem em uma pista de boliche na Flórida. Depois, investiu em uma loja de donuts com o pai, vendeu serviços de ar-condicionado e construiu carreira no setor de instalações residenciais.

Em 2003, criou a Strada Services, empresa que instala e presta manutenção em sistemas elétricos, de ar-condicionado, hidráulicos e de segurança para construtoras e proprietários de imóveis.

Hoje, aos 63 anos, Strada é presidente executivo da companhia, que registrou receita de US$ 534 milhões em 2025 e tem mais de 4 mil funcionários em 13 estados. A Forbes estima seu patrimônio em US$ 800 milhões.

A trajetória também entra na política americana. Strada venceu a indicação republicana para disputar uma vaga no Congresso pelo 11º distrito da Flórida. Entre suas pautas estão críticas ao excesso de regulação e propostas contra operações financeiras suspeitas feitas por parlamentares.

“Não estou indo para lá para ficar rico. Eu já trabalhei e fiquei rico”, afirma.

WHATSAPP BUSINESS PASSA A COBRAR POR MENSAGEM

A partir deste mês, a Meta cobra das empresas que usam a API oficial do WhatsApp Business pelas mensagens entregues, com franquia de 1.000 mensagens gratuitas por mês por número. Usuários do WhatsApp comum e do aplicativo gratuito não são afetados.

No Brasil, cada mensagem custará R$ 0,035 — tanto as de serviço (enviadas por funcionário ou IA dentro de 24 horas) quanto as de utilidade, como confirmação de compra.

"Até agora, muitas empresas mediam eficiência pelo tempo de resposta. A partir de outubro, será preciso olhar também para a quantidade de mensagens necessárias para resolver cada atendimento", diz Guilherme Rocha, CEO da HelenaCRM.

O impacto deve ser maior para varejo, e-commerce e plataformas de entrega, que dependem de grande volume de mensagens. "Não dá mais para tratar a questão como ajuste fino: será preciso uma revisão profunda da operação conversacional", avalia Rafael Pacheco, CEO da Wiv.

A mudança deve impulsionar a diversificação de canais, como RCS, chats de site, Instagram e agentes de IA.

It was such a pleasure to introduce @lisanandymp , and hearing her publicly double down on the Government’s support for Georgia’s Law (and vawg in general) following the Prime Minister’s support, was a pretty surreal moment for me.

We’ve had such a positive reaction from Government. Now comes the slightly less glamorous bit… figuring out exactly how we turn that support into legislation 💪

Changing the law isn’t as simple as everyone agreeing it’s a good idea and popping it into the rule book 😂 There’s a lot that has to happen behind the scenes to get the wording right, find the right legislative route and make sure it actually works in practice. So there’s still work to do, but having this level of support is a huge step forward.

I genuinely can feel an uprising on this issue on social media. My fellow vawg campaigners posts are all getting more support than ever and the louis Theroux doc helped so much to give everyone a window into the world of toxic masculinity.

So thank you to everyone who has supported this campaign, shared my posts and kept the conversation going. You lot have basically had a free ticket to Labour Conference through my Instagram this week 😂❤️ But every share and every conversation genuinely helps.

The support for Georgia’s Law is there. Now we have to turn that support into something real. ❤️

Misogyny isn’t just something women experience online it’s shaping how a generation of young men and boys see women in the real world. Look at the Cornell University case - 7 men raped an unconscious woman - 50 more were watching the chat brag about it as it happened AND DID NOTHING. This is a global epidemic…

That’s why I wanted to use my speech at Labour Party Conference to talk about the rise of online misogyny, the manosphere and the content being pushed towards young people every single day.

Because if we’re serious about tackling violence against women and girls, we have to be serious about where some of these attitudes are being learned in the first place.

For me, this is a huge part of what my new campaign is about — making the online world safer for women and children, but also challenging the culture that allows misogyny to grow and spread.

I’ll be sharing more of my speech tomorrow, as well as my conversation with @lisanandymp about the campaign, what we’re trying to achieve and why I believe this needs urgent attention.

Pakistan’s federal government has given civil servants who have yet to disclose their foreign nationality status — and that of their dependants — one week to submit the required declarations. The Establishment Division said non-compliance could lead to proceedings under the Civil Servants (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 2020, while false declarations may constitute misconduct. 

The requirement covers foreign citizenship, foreign travel documents and marriage to a foreign national. Officials are required to make declarations when joining government service, annually, and whenever their or their dependants’ foreign citizenship-related status changes. The directive specifically noted that a number of PAS, PSP, Secretariat Group and Office Management Group officers had yet to submit their declarations. 

In cases where relevant facts were concealed at the time of appointment, the appointment itself may also be declared void.

Pakistan’s Ministry of Religious Affairs has set October 20, 2026, as the deadline for pilgrims selected under the government Hajj scheme to deposit their second instalment. Payments can be made from October 5 to 20 through the Pak Hajj App or digital Hajj portal, with pilgrims required to upload their medical fitness certificate beforehand.

The ministry has warned that applications will be cancelled if the payment is not made by the deadline, while previously deposited amounts will be refunded. For the upcoming Hajj, the government scheme has been allocated 107,526 slots, including 30,000 for the shorter package. The announced cost is Rs1.2 million for the 40-day package and Rs1.3 million for the 20–25-day package.

Pakistan staged a remarkable comeback to defeat South Korea 5-3 and win the men’s hockey bronze medal at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya on Saturday. Pakistan took an early lead through Sufyan Khan, but South Korea responded with three goals to move 3-1 ahead before Abdul Rehman pulled one back just before half-time. Rana Waheed Ashraf then scored twice in the final quarter to complete Pakistan’s comeback and put the team 4-3 ahead, before Hannan Shahid sealed the victory with a late goal. Pakistan had reached the bronze-medal match after losing 4-3 to India in the semi-final, having finished second in Pool B with four wins and one defeat. The bronze adds another medal to Pakistan’s 2026 Asian Games campaign.

More than 11,400 Israelis entered the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound in occupied East Jerusalem between September 12 and October 1 during the Jewish holiday season, according to the Palestinian Jerusalem Governorate. The authority said 9,138 entries were recorded during the first five days of Sukkot alone, with the pace of visits increasing during the holiday period. 

Palestinian officials said the visits were accompanied by increasingly public religious rituals inside the compound, including prayers and other ceremonies, and warned that the developments were affecting the site’s longstanding status quo.

The Group of Seven (G7) countries have agreed to a coordinated release of 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil from emergency reserves in an effort to ease surging fuel prices linked to the Iran war and wider supply disruptions. The move follows pressure from US President Donald Trump for allies to help stabilise energy markets. 

The release will begin immediately and continue over four months, with a substantial amount of diesel expected to enter the market within the first 20 days. G7 members also pledged to avoid new energy export restrictions as part of the coordinated response.

Apple Music has officially arrived in Pakistan, 11 years after its global launch in June 2015, giving local listeners another major option for streaming their favourite music.

Subscriptions start at Rs379 per month for the Individual plan, while the Family plan costs Rs649 per month. Eligible new users can also try the service with a one month free trial.

Subscribers gain access to Apple’s catalogue of songs, albums and playlists, alongside personalised recommendations and offline downloads. Lossless audio and Dolby Atmos are also available where supported, offering listeners more ways to experience their music through compatible devices.

For Pakistani users, the biggest change is local account access. Listeners can now subscribe through Apple accounts registered in Pakistan and use the Music app without relying on an account set to a different region.

Pakistan joins Albania, Brunei and Burkina Faso in the latest expansion. According to the report, the updated availability was spotted in Apple’s Media Services information on September 30, marking the end of a wait lasting more than a decade.

Source: The Express Tribune.

I thought I’d share in case anyone else has an almost-5 year old home “sick,” or just home in general, and wants some age-appropriate chores that actually proved to be pretty helpful today. To my surprise, he thoroughly enjoyed them — he even asked tonight before bed if he could be my helper every day after school and on the weekends!

first, I had him flip through one of my cookbooks to choose a few recipes he’d like for dinners this week (and one for a dessert), so that I could order a few groceries while he got to work on his next assignment. he chose halibut sandwiches, cauliflower lavash pizzas, a sausage dish, and chimichurri steak lol

he helped me get a bunch of towels from the dryer and folded them as I ordered groceries 

next, he asked me if he could wash the dishes in the sink, but we realized the dishwasher was full, so he unloaded it (I assisted with bigger/more fragile things).

we had a big bag of random socks that had accumulated from laundry overtime so we played a “matching game” and he paired all the socks with their lost counterparts. he was very excited every time he found a match.

he took a well-earned break for a popsicle outside 

then came back in to work on the dishes in the sink.

he worked on his school homework over lunch.

then he volunteered to accompany me to do some pruning the yard and suggested we bring a basket to pick some flowers for the house, so we did!

Hoje eu me sinto inteira.

Que venha um novo ciclo. ✨

Eu só peço a Jesus que continue guiando meus passos, protegendo a minha família, realizando os sonhos que estão no meu coração e, acima de tudo, que eu nunca me esqueça de onde Ele me tirou e de tudo o que já fez por mim.

Feliz nova fase para mim. 🤍🎂✨

Eu olho para essa foto e meus olhos simplesmente não conseguem conter as lágrimas. 🥹🤍

Na mesma hora, eu me lembro daquela menina que eu fui… que sonhava em saber se um dia conseguiria se casar vestida de noiva.

Naquela época, esse sonho parecia tão distante. Eu olhava para a minha mãe e para a minha avó, que nunca tinham se casado nem no civil. Nossa família era pobre, e na minha cabeça casamento era coisa de gente que tinha muito dinheiro. Eu me perguntava: “Será que um dia eu vou ter condições de viver isso?”

E Deus foi tão generoso comigo… que não realizou esse sonho apenas uma vez.

Duas vezes eu me vesti de noiva para dizer SIM ao homem que Deus escolheu para caminhar ao meu lado. 🤍

Eu também sonhava em ser mãe de um casal de filhos… e Deus, mais uma vez, foi além dos meus sonhos: me deu três. Três filhos que fizeram meu coração transbordar e me fizeram ainda mais realizada na maternidade.

Às vezes eu nem encontro palavras suficientes para agradecer a Deus.

Porque, quando minha mãe morreu e eu vi a minha família se despedaçar, por muito tempo tive medo de nunca mais saber o que era me sentir completa. Eu tinha medo de nunca mais ter aquela sensação de família, de casa, de pertencimento.

E hoje eu olho para tudo o que Deus construiu ao meu redor e entendo: Ele estava escrevendo uma nova história para mim.

Hoje eu posso dizer que sou completa.

E sou rica. Muito rica.

Rica daquilo que dinheiro nenhum no mundo pode comprar: uma família feliz, unida, que se ama, que escolhe permanecer junta e que tem Deus como alicerce. ❤️

Como eu sempre digo: a vida nem sempre é cor-de-rosa. Existem dias difíceis, tempestades e momentos em que parece que tudo vai sair do lugar…

Mas, se Jesus está no barco, eu sei que posso descansar até no meio da tempestade.

Porque com Ele, eu estou segura. 🙏🏻✨

Obrigada, Deus, por ter realizado sonhos que aquela menina nem sabia se um dia seriam possíveis.

E obrigada por ter feito ainda mais do que ela sonhou. 🤍

Making fall/halloween cake pops with my daughter Kali! 🎃 (Recipe + Instructions below) 

Low Sugar Toddler Halloween Cake Pops

Toddler friendly cake pops made with whole ingredients and low sugar!

INGREDIENTS

Cake Base
• 1½ cups oat flour
• 1 tsp baking powder
• ¼ tsp salt
• 1 medium ripe banana, mashed
• ⅓ cup pure maple syrup
• 2 large eggs
• 3 tbsp melted butter or coconut oil
• 2 tsp vanilla extract

Binder
• 3 to 4 tbsp Tillamook cream cheese, softened

Shell + Decor
• 6 oz Lily’s White Chocolate Chips
• 2 tsp coconut oil
• Natural plant based food dye, orange 
• Optional: candy eyes or melted dark chocolate for faces + sprinkles 

INSTRUCTIONS

1. Bake: Whisk dry ingredients together. Stir in wet ingredients and pour into an 8x8 pan. Bake at 350°F for 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.

2. Cool: Let the cake cool completely to room temperature. You can also freeze it for 10 minutes. Do not mix while warm.

3. Mix + Shape: Crumble cooled cake into fine crumbs. Mix in cream cheese until a fudgy dough forms. Firmly press into pumpkin molds and pop onto a parchment lined tray.

4. Add Sticks: Melt Lily’s chocolate with 1 tsp coconut oil in 20 second intervals. Dip each lollipop stick into chocolate, push into the bottom of each pumpkin, (or shape into ball) then freeze for 15 minutes.

5. Dip + Decorate: Mix 1 tsp warm coconut oil with natural food dye until emulsified. Stir into melted white chocolate. Dip frozen pops into chocolate, tap off excess, then add candy eyes or piped faces.

6. Set: Refrigerate for 10 to 15 minutes, until the shell is firm.

STORAGE
• Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 5 days.
• Let sit at room temperature for 10 minutes before serving so the inside stays soft.

My wife was craving a Blueberry Grilled Cheese so I made it from scratch!  @theerealkarlaj (Full Recipe Below) 

Blueberry Grilled Cheese 🫐🧀🍞

Makes 4 sandwiches

Ingredients
• 2 cups (10–12 oz) frozen blueberries
• ¼ cup sugar
• Juice of 1 lemon (2 tbsp)
• 8 slices regular or heritage sourdough (½-inch thick)
• 6 oz sharp white cheddar, grated
• 6 oz whole milk mozzarella, shredded
• Honey (1–2 tsp per sandwich)
• 4 tbsp butter
• Flaky sea salt (optional)

Instructions

1. Simmer blueberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium-low heat for 20–30 minutes until thick. Cool 10–15 minutes.
2. Spread 2–3 tbsp jam on 4 slices of bread. Top each with 1½ oz cheddar, ½ oz mozzarella, and 1–2 tsp honey. Add the remaining bread and butter the outsides.
3. Cook over medium-low heat for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and the cheese is melted. Cover for the last 1–2 minutes if needed.
4. Finish with flaky sea salt, slice, and enjoy!

In western culture, the idea of success is driven by the masculine principles of action, force, assertion, defending your position 💪 powered by our natural survival instinct of FIGHT or FLIGHT. You hear it often, “go hard or go home, all or nothing” and success is measured by winning by any means “winner takes all” 🏆

This is absolutely useful when the time calls for it. But when you live in that constant state of survival, that same force used to protect your life, can start consuming it. 

So let’s compare Flight or Fight with FLOW & FLOAT as philosophical archetypes of in the Law of Nature. 

🌀YANG is the masculine traits you see in Fight or Flight, that moves outward with action, assertion and force. 

🌀YIN is the feminine trait that receives, adapts, & responds. 

Lao Tzu uses water as the metaphor for Yin. Looks soft, but it can cut through mountains. Have you seen the Grand Canyon? 🛘 That is the power of water💧It doesn’t waste energy arguing with the mountain, it finds the opening and creates its own way.

I think that is where many of us can get stuck. When chaos hits, we tighten our grip. We seek control to ground us. But if you step back and switch your strategy to YIN as a means for harmony to find balance and contain your emotion for a moment… if you refuse to let crisis become an emergency inside your spirit. The fire, the conflict, the pressure fizzles out. Now you can focus on what actually needs to be done. Flow & Float. 

Sometimes strength looks like fire🔥
Sometimes it looks like water 🌊 

When life gets chaotic, what do you default to?

Picture this: You go sit down for an hour of quiet and within 10 minutes, an internal checklist fires off and the mind race begins 🐎 in those 10 min, you’ve done due diligence to your to do list and the guilt settles in. You feel like resting is a violation of productivity, as if peace is something you have to earn rather than a space you own. I believe this is called “the anxious toil” waking up early, staying up late, and carrying the weight of the world because you’ve been sold the lie that everything will collapse if you stop managing every variable. As women we often aim to be like a “Proverbs 31 woman” To me, she is someone who operates as a high level sovereign manager of her domain, not like a servant wearing battle armor. She commands an estate, she has help, she delegates tasks, enforces order. She is not running around in panic or giving her family the crumbs of her energy - she is not UNDER control, she is IN control and that’s why “…she laughs without fear of the future.”

It seems there are aspects of womanhood our generation was influenced to forget in exchange for …social validation? 🤔 and I think our innate need for group conformity. As performative culture began to replace genuine expression, a collective reaction to follow trends and what’s cool, we gave up our strengths for whatever was in at the moment. 

Over time, being feminine was looked at as weakness. You know how ‘tradwives’ is often an eye roll. Days and days without make-up and hair left to air dry. Endless games of Monopoly Go and UNO, book after book, pizza, pasta and Aperol. Reservations for 20 because, there’s never just a few of us.

I learnt how important it is to switch off at times. To stop thinking about capturing the moment and just be in it.

One whole month of la dolce vita. As always, Italy, you have my heart. Until next summer 🇮🇹

Бёдра: 81 → 70 см, −11 см
Нога: 57 → 53 см, −4 см

И самое классное, что к этому результату я пришла не одна. Всё это время мы вместе с девочками в моём закрытом комьюнити тренировались, следили за питанием, делились результатами, поддерживали и мотивировали друг друга. ❤️

Когда рядом есть люди, которые идут к своей цели вместе с тобой, всё действительно становится проще.

А я точно не собираюсь останавливаться 😏🔥 Это только начало. Хочу посмотреть, что будет ещё через пару месяцев.

Котик на видео максимально точно передаёт моё настроение от этих замеров 😂💃🔥

🚢 ЧТО Я НЕ ЗНАЛА ПЕРЕД ПЕРВЫМ КРУИЗОМ

Когда я собирала чемодан на Costa Smeralda, оказалось, что есть вещи, которые нельзя просто взять с собой на лайнер.

И самое болезненное для меня 😂 пришлось оставить дома мой Dyson.

На борт нельзя брать определенные электроприборы с нагревательными элементами. Поэтому мой привычный набор для волос остался дома 🥲

И, пожалуй, это был единственный момент круиза, с которым мне действительно было сложно смириться 😂 Потому что мои волосы без нормальной укладки живут какой-то своей отдельной жизнью.

Фен в каюте был, но для моих волос его возможностей оказалось маловато. Поэтому большую часть круиза я проходила с кудряшками 😂 Разнообразие причесок за 7 дней получилось примерно такое:

кудряшки → кудряшки → снова кудряшки.

Но зато теперь я знаю, что перед следующим круизом нужно изучать не только маршрут, погоду и экскурсии, но еще и список того, что разрешено брать на борт 😂🚢

И это, кстати, далеко не единственное, что удивило нас во время первого круиза.

Хотите вторую часть с вещами, которые я бы хотела знать ДО поездки? 👀

ДЕНЬ 7. МАРСЕЛЬ 🇫🇷 ФИНАЛ НАШЕГО КРУИЗА 🚢🤍

Седьмой день. Последний полноценный день нашего круиза 🥹 И последней остановкой стал Марсель, Франция 🇫🇷

Сразу скажу: Марсель нас очень впечатлил! Это огромный город, и мы на 100% решили, что обязательно вернемся сюда еще раз. Только уже отдельно, на несколько дней, чтобы никуда не торопиться и спокойно все посмотреть.

От порта мы взяли такси и доехали до Старого города. А там снова выбрали наш любимый формат путешествий с детьми 😂 туристический паровозик! 🚂

Маршрут длился примерно 1 час 20 минут и проходил по очень красивым местам Марселя. А главной точкой стала Basilique Notre-Dame de la Garde ⛪️

Она находится высоко над городом, и оттуда открывается просто невероятный вид на Марсель и море 😍 Масштабы города особенно хорошо понимаешь именно сверху.

Единственное, людей было ОЧЕНЬ много 😂 В какой-то момент мы поняли, что вообще не чувствуем разницы между количеством людей на нашем огромном лайнере и в центре Марселя.

ДЕНЬ 6. САВОНА 🇮🇹🚢

Шестой день нашего круиза и еще одна остановка в Италии. На этот раз мы приплыли в Савону 🇮🇹

День решили начать с туристического паровозика 🚂 И это оказалась просто замечательная идея, особенно с детьми 😂 Им понравилось само развлечение, а мы тем временем смогли спокойно посмотреть историческую часть Савоны, не наматывая километры пешком. Все довольны!

После паровозика решили уже немного прогуляться ножками. Зашли в кафе, дети поели мороженого 🍦, мы выпили кофе и какао ☕️ По дороге заглядывали в маленькие магазинчики, рассматривали город и, конечно же, фотографировались 📸

А потом отправились к Fortezza del Priamar 🏰

Это огромная крепость прямо у моря, откуда открываются очень красивые виды сразу и на Савону, и на побережье. Мы поднялись наверх, прогулялись по территории, подышали свежим морским воздухом и просто наслаждались видами 🌊

Вообще Савона получилась очень приятной и комфортной остановкой. Здесь не было ощущения, что нужно куда-то бежать и срочно пытаться увидеть все достопримечательности за несколько часов. Просто спокойный итальянский день ❤️

После прогулки вернулись на лайнер, немного отдохнули, потому что вечером нас снова ждала программа 💃🏼

В этот раз на корабле проходила White Party 🤍, и практически весь лайнер превратился в одну большую белую вечеринку 😂 Очень прикольно наблюдать, когда огромное количество пассажиров одновременно поддерживает один дресс-код.

Вообще на Costa практически каждый день была какая-то тематическая вечеринка и свой дресс-код. Конечно, это не обязательно, и соблюдают его далеко не все. Кто хочет и заранее подготовился, одевается по теме, остальные приходят как обычно. Никаких проблем с этим нет.

Но когда большинство все-таки поддерживает тему, выглядит это очень эффектно 😍

Больше всего мне запомнились два вечера: когда все были в черном 🖤 и когда все были в белом 🤍. Совершенно разная атмосфера, хотя находишься все на том же корабле.

Вот таким получился наш шестой день: Савона, туристический паровозик, мороженое, прогулка по крепости, красивые виды и белая вечеринка посреди моря 🚢🤍

И впереди у нас оставался уже практически финал нашего круиза… 🥹

ДЕНЬ 5. ЧИВИТАВЕККЬЯ 🇮🇹🚢

Пятый день нашего круиза, и очередная остановка в Италии 🇮🇹 На этот раз мы приплыли в Чивитавеккью, небольшой портовый город недалеко от Рима.

Сама Чивитавеккья довольно спокойная и небольшая, а большинство туристов используют эту остановку как возможность съездить в Рим. Конечно, мы тоже рассматривали этот вариант.

Но потом посчитали время и поняли, что с двумя детьми нам такая поездка вообще не подходит 😂 Нужно заложить примерно три часа только на дорогу туда и обратно, а потом за оставшееся время пытаться быстренько пробежаться по главным достопримечательностям Рима.

Колизей, Ватикан, фонтан Треви, все хочется увидеть, но делать это в режиме «быстрее, быстрее, нам еще обратно на лайнер» нам совершенно не хотелось 😅

Поэтому мы вполне осознанно решили: в Рим не едем! Лучше однажды приехать туда отдельно на несколько дней и действительно насладиться городом, чем пытаться вместить Рим в несколько часов.

Вместо этого мы решили устроить себе максимально спокойный день ❤️ Взяли туристический автобус, прокатились по Чивитавеккье, посмотрели город, зашли в магазины, купили детям игрушки и без спешки вернулись обратно на лайнер 🚢

И знаете что? Нам вообще не было обидно, что мы не поехали в Рим.

После нескольких очень насыщенных дней такой день оказался именно тем, что было нужно. Никуда не бежать, ничего не пытаться успеть, не смотреть каждые пять минут на часы и не переживать, успеем ли мы обратно на корабль 😂

Просто гуляли, отдыхали и наслаждались самим путешествием.

В общем, пятый день прошел, как сейчас говорят, на чиле, на расслабоне 😂🤌🏻

И, пожалуй, в круизе такие дни тоже очень нужны. Потому что невозможно каждую остановку превращать в марафон по достопримечательностям. Иногда лучший план на день это вообще никуда не спешить ❤️🚢

ДЕНЬ 4. ПАЛЕРМО, СИЦИЛИЯ 🇮🇹🍋

На четвертый день нашего круиза мы приплыли в Палермо, на остров Сицилия 🇮🇹

И первое, что мы почувствовали, когда вышли с лайнера, это ЖАРА 😂 На улице было около +35°C, поэтому семейный совет длился недолго: город сегодня не смотрим, едем на пляж! 😂

Гулять по достопримечательностям в такую жару с двумя детьми показалось нам не самой лучшей идеей, поэтому мы нашли Mondello Beach и отправились туда 🏖️

И пляж оказался просто потрясающим! 😍 Невероятно красивая лазурная вода, мелкий светлый песочек и настоящая атмосфера Сицилии 💙

Дети, конечно, были в полном восторге. Для них главное преимущество песчаного пляжа очевидно: можно строить башенки! 😂 В итоге практически все время они провели то в воде, то в песке.

Мы взяли лежаки и зонтик, потому что находиться под открытым солнцем при +35°C было просто невозможно ☀️ Зато под зонтиком уже можно было спокойно расслабиться и наслаждаться этим невероятным морем.

После пляжа мы немного прогулялись вдоль набережной и увидели Charleston, Palazzina Liberty. Очень красивое историческое здание прямо на воде 😍 Конечно же, остановились, пофотографировались, немного заглянули внутрь. Там находится ресторан, но заходить поесть мы уже не стали. Продолжение 👇

ДЕНЬ 3. ЦЕЛЫЙ ДЕНЬ В МОРЕ 🌊🚢

Третий день нашего круиза мы провели полностью на воде. Никаких остановок, никаких городов. Это был самый длинный промежуток за весь маршрут, когда мы просто плыли 🌊

И я думала, что вот тут-то нам станет скучно… Но вообще НЕТ 😂 Лайнер настолько огромный, что за целый день мы все равно не успели обойти и попробовать всё.

На борту постоянно проходят разные развлекательные программы, есть как минимум две большие детские зоны, куда дети уходили с огромным удовольствием 😁 А я наконец-то добралась до спортзала! И это был, наверное, самый красивый спортзал в моей жизни 😂 Тренируешься, а перед тобой через огромные окна бесконечное море. Я получила невероятный кайф от этой тренировки 🏋🏼‍♀️🌊

А еще практически весь путь за нашим лайнером летели чайки. Не знаю почему, но наблюдать за ними посреди моря было невероятно красиво 🤍

На лайнере огромное количество ресторанов. Есть те, которые уже включены в стоимость круиза, а есть дополнительные, где платишь отдельно. Мы, например, зашли в кафе, где готовят блинчики, продают мороженое, разные сладости и очень вкусный кофе ☕️🍦🥞 Конечно, пройти мимо мы не смогли 😂

Сам Costa Smeralda очень красивый и достаточно новый, его ввели в эксплуатацию в 2019 году. Внутри столько красивых локаций, что мне хотелось фотографироваться буквально ВЕЗДЕ 📸😂

Есть на борту и несколько бассейнов: один крытый и два под открытым небом. Но вот тут случилось мое единственное разочарование 😅 Они очень маленькие! Для такого огромного количества людей прям ОЧЕНЬ. Народу было столько, что мы с мужем даже не стали туда заходить 😂

Но попробуйте объяснить детям, что мы живем неделю на огромном корабле с бассейнами и купаться в них нельзя 🤣 Конечно, они пошли плавать. Правда, хватило их буквально на несколько минут, быстро надоело, и мы отправились исследовать лайнер дальше.

В итоге день, от которого я ожидала меньше всего, оказался очень насыщенным. Целый день посреди моря, никуда не спешишь, ничего не нужно успевать и просто наслаждаешься самим лайнером. 🚢🤍

И знаете что? Именно в такой день начинаешь понимать, что в круизе сам корабль тоже часть путешествия. 🌊✨

ДЕНЬ 2. ИБИЦА 🏝️🚢

Первая остановка нашего круиза была на Ибице 🤍 Я уже была здесь в прошлом году, причем тоже в сентябре, поэтому в этот раз мы решили не пытаться посмотреть все и сразу, а просто провести несколько часов у моря.

Мы выбрали пляж Таламанка, потому что он находится совсем недалеко от места стоянки нашего лайнера. Времени на Ибице у нас было немного, а мы уже наслушались историй о туристах, которые опаздывали на посадку и наблюдали, как их лайнер уплывает без них 😂 Поэтому весь круиз мы всегда рассчитывали время с хорошим запасом и старались далеко от порта не уезжать.

Дети от пляжа были в полном восторге 🥹 Здесь песочек, можно строить замки и башенки, бегать у воды и просто наслаждаться морем. В общем, для них идеальная остановка 🏖️

После пляжа мы вернулись в район порта, немного погуляли по улочкам Ибицы, сделали фотографии, посмотрели сувениры и спокойно вернулись на лайнер 🚢

Кстати, на борту у нас завтраки, обеды и ужины, а также практически вся развлекательная программа уже входили в стоимость круиза. И вечером скучать здесь точно не приходится 😁

Этот день закончился отличной тусовкой: диджей, музыка, танцевальная программа и совершенно особенная атмосфера ✨ Нам очень понравилось!

А самое классное для родителей то, что пока мы были на взрослой вечеринке, дети отлично проводили время в большой детской игровой зоне. Их там можно оставить под присмотром сотрудников, и это не просто комната, где дети предоставлены сами себе. У них каждый день расписана целая программа: игры, активности и разные развлечения.

Наши дети туда бежали с огромным удовольствием, а мы наконец-то могли спокойно пойти потанцевать 😂🤍

Вот таким получился наш первый полноценный день круиза. Ибица, море, прогулки, танцы и ощущение, что отпуск наконец-то начался по-настоящему! 🚢🌊

ДЕНЬ 1. НАШ КРУИЗ НАЧИНАЕТСЯ 🚢🤍

Ну что, мы заехали на лайнер! 😍 Для нашего путешествия мы выбрали Costa Smeralda, а отправлялись из Барселоны 🇪🇸 

Первым делом после посадки прошли обязательное обучение: нам показали, как правильно надевать и снимать спасательные жилеты и что делать в случае экстренной ситуации.

После всех организационных моментов отправились на обед 🍝 А первый вечер решили вообще никуда не спешить.

Просто ходили по лайнеру и изучали наш огромный плавучий дом на ближайшие дни 😁 Смотрели, где что находится, какие здесь рестораны, бассейны, развлечения, как вообще все выглядит и устроено.

Первый день получился именно таким: знакомство с лайнером, первые впечатления и осознание: мы действительно отправились в круиз! 🚢✨

La vita è un attimo.
Ci penso da mesi.Mi chiedo se ho fatto,dato,detto,provato o lasciato abbastanza.Se chi doveva comprendere la mia anima l'ha fatto davvero. Cosa resterà di lei agli altri?La terranno con cura?Mio figlio cosa penserà di me?
La vita è imprevedibile,ogni giorno potrebbe essere l'ultimo e..con la tragedia successa, non faccio altro che pensare: A quanto rinunciamo,al dolore che possiamo evitare se solo avessimo coraggio di vivere a pieno con verità,senza paura, se solo avessimo delle persone accanto in grado di vederci davvero.Cosa ci fa felici? Quando vi guardate allo specchio chi siete? State vivendo la vita che volete?A cosa pensiamo prima di dormire? Il nostro pensiero dove va?Forse va a proteggere tutto quello che è rimasto lì a galleggiare.
Ieri ho portato mio figlio allo stadio, e nel silenzio, mentre dormiva,all'andata e al ritorno pensavo che quello che è successo sabato notte può succedere a chiunque: a me,te,voi,i nostri figli.Come reagiremmo?Ho iniziato a tremare.E ho pensato all'impotenza.Sì,lei,
quella che ci manda tutti in terapia: chi per un viaggio di andata, chi per quello di ritorno.
Ho pensato alle cose non vissute stese come i panni ad un filo rosso,alle parole non dette,ferme in gola che la dignità, l'orgoglio, lo status sociale,la paura,non ne permettono il volo. La vita è piena di ultime volte che non sappiamo essere tali, ci avete mai pensato?
L'ultima volta che abbiamo abbracciato forte,che un sorriso ci ha dato serenità, all'intensità di uno sguardo o quando abbiamo sentito il battito accelerare!L'ultimo tremolìo del corpo ve lo ricordate? Quel regalo comprato e messo in un cassetto aspettando il momento giusto che non esiste.Quei fiori che non abbiamo mandato.E quell'ultimo caffè?Al posto del miele,le lacrime.L'ultima volta che abbiamo sentito quella voce?Quella risata che ci rimbomba ancora in piena notte. L'ultima volta che abbiamo abbracciato quell'amica.L'ultima volta che avete fatto l'amore pensando a qualcun altro.L'ultima volta che avete fatto l'amore sperando restasse per sempre.L'ultima volta che avete spiato qualcuno in silenzio,l'ultimo vocale che ascoltiamo tutti i giorni...( continua al primo commento)

A friend sent me a message this morning that meant more to me than any payment could.

He told me that the way I live, what I share, and the conversations we've had have helped him change his life.

He's never been my client. He's someone I genuinely care about.

We've had heart-to-heart conversations about things he'd been carrying quietly. Seeing him open up about what he'd been afraid people would judge him for made me so happy.

I won't share the details. They're his to tell.

But his message reminded me why I choose to do this work.

I love seeing people let go of what has been weighing on them. Seeing them become honest with themselves and make choices they used to be afraid to make.

I bring that same care to my clients. I go above and beyond because their lives matter to me beyond the time we spend on a call.

Every time a client messages me about something that's changing, I feel it. I know what it took for them to get there.

I've seen every client I've worked with make progress. I'm proud of that.

I know I'm very good at what I do. And I genuinely, truly care about the person in front of me. That care shapes how I listen, the questions I ask, and when I push them to face something they've been avoiding.

Something changed in my 30s.

In my 20s, so much of what I did was about money.

Today, I choose this work because it gives me purpose. Helping people change their lives is the mission I want to spend my life on.

I see money as an exchange of energy. It supports the work and the life I'm building.

But no amount gives me the feeling I get when someone tells me that our conversations helped them change.

That is a blessing. It's the best gift this work gives me.

And it matters just as much when that person is a friend.

You don't have to impress me to be my friend. You don't have to have everything figured out.

I can want more for you and still appreciate exactly who you are today.

To my friend, if you're reading this: thank you for trusting me. I'm proud of you.

"I want to sleep with 5-10 more really hot women before I settle down."

That's what a client told me.

So I asked him:

"You've already experienced that. What are ten more going to give you? What is the FEELING you're looking for?"

Validation? Excitement? Proof that you're desirable?

What happens after those ten?

If you haven't understood what you're chasing, you can keep moving the number and never feel ready.

And finding the right woman doesn't mean you'll never find another woman attractive.

You can love your wife and still notice an attractive woman. What you choose to entertain, pursue or act on is your responsibility.

People ask me how I stay faithful in Medellín.

I practiced saying no while I was single.

I could turn down an attractive woman, a threesome, an opportunity I wanted. I learned to experience desire without letting it make every decision for me.

That's something I brought INTO my relationship.

A relationship won't automatically give you the self-control you've never practiced. Start practicing before you expect someone else to trust your commitment.

In business, there's always another opportunity. Chasing every one leaves you scattered.

The same fear of missing out can keep you half committed to a woman you say you want a future with.

When you agree to be exclusive, honor that agreement. Give the relationship your attention. Stop entertaining alternatives while expecting her to feel secure with you.

If the relationship isn't right, you can leave honestly. While you're in it, take responsibility for your word.

The more powerful the question you ask, the more powerful the change.

Stop believing everything you feel.

“I feel insecure” becomes “I'm an insecure person.”

“I feel unmotivated” becomes “I'm lazy.”

“I feel lost” becomes “I have no direction.”

“I feel anxious” becomes “I'm an anxious person.”

Be careful.

You're taking a temporary emotional state and turning it into an identity.

There's a big difference between:

“I am insecure.”

and

“I'm experiencing insecurity right now.”

One defines you.

The other describes something you're currently experiencing.

And this isn't about suppressing your emotions.

Emotional control is not emotional suppression.

You can feel fear and still take action.

You can feel insecure and still speak confidently.

You can feel angry without allowing anger to control your behavior.

You can feel unmotivated and still keep your word.

Your emotions can give you information.

They don't always need to give you instructions.

Day 22 of The 3 Minute Protocol.

Take three minutes today and ask yourself:

What am I feeling right now?

What story am I attaching to this feeling?

What would the man I'm becoming do even while feeling this?

Maybe you don't need to feel confident before taking action.

Maybe taking action while you feel uncomfortable is part of how you build confidence.

You don't need to wait until you feel different to behave differently.

Feel it.

Understand it.

Then choose your response.

Your emotions are part of your experience.

They don't have to become your identity.

Yesterday I sat through 7 hours of getting tattooed.

I'm getting tattooed again today.

And again tomorrow.

And I STILL did my 3-minute plank.

I could've easily said:

“I went through seven hours of pain yesterday. I deserve a day off.”

And it would've sounded like a pretty good reason.

But was it actually a reason?

Or was it an excuse giving me permission to choose comfort?

There's an important difference.

We naturally tend to value immediate comfort, and when something requires effort or discomfort, it becomes easier to justify choosing the easier option.

Your brain can give you a reason.

Your identity decides whether that reason becomes an excuse.

And I'm not saying you should ignore your body.

If you're injured, sick or genuinely need recovery, REST.

But learn the difference between:

“My body needs recovery.”

and

“I don't feel like being uncomfortable today.”

My tattoo doesn't prevent me from doing a plank.

So I didn't allow it to become my excuse.

Remember the evidence bank?

This is another deposit.

I showed up when it would've been easier not to.

And every time I do that, I reinforce:

I follow through.
I don't need perfect conditions.
I can experience discomfort and still keep my word.

Day 17 of The 3-Minute Protocol:

Catch ONE excuse today and ask yourself:

“Is this a legitimate reason to stop, or am I simply trying to avoid discomfort?”

If it's legitimate, adjust.

If it's discomfort, do it anyway.

Your new identity isn't built only when everything goes perfectly.

It's built when you could've made an excuse and chose to show up anyway.

Michael B. Jordan é a estrela da edição de outubro da Vogue americana. Fotografado por Luis Alberto Rodriguez e com styling de Carlos Nazario, o ator aparece na capa com um conjunto da Dolce & Gabbana, em meio a um jardim em Londres.

A edição acompanha uma entrevista sobre a atual fase da carreira de Jordan, que venceu neste ano o Oscar de Melhor Ator por Sinners e trabalha em sua nova versão de The Thomas Crown Affair, na qual atua, produz e dirige.

Após quase oito décadas, a Rolex reviveu o nome Padellone em um novo relógio da coleção Perpetual. Apresentado em setembro , o modelo tem caixa de 39 mm e reúne calendário anual completo, fases da Lua e o novo calibre 7190.

Duas aberturas às 12 horas exibem o dia da semana e o mês, enquanto a data é indicada por um ponteiro central azul com uma pequena lua crescente na ponta. O sistema Haplos permite ao mecanismo distinguir meses de 30 e 31 dias. Com isso, o calendário necessita de apenas uma correção anual, no fim de fevereiro. As três indicações mudam instantaneamente à meia-noite.

Outro destaque aparece às 6 horas: o disco azul de fases da Lua completa uma volta a cada 29,53 dias e utiliza meteorito para representar a Lua Cheia e a Lua Nova. O Padellone será oferecido em ouro Everose 18 quilates e platina 950, com opções de pulseira metálica Settimo ou couro de aligátor.

Roger Federer e Thierry Henry se encontraram em Londres, durante a Laver Cup — e, curiosamente, apostaram em fórmulas praticamente idênticas no look: polo, calça de alfaiataria e tênis. Federer seguiu pelo caminho mais clássico, com polo preta de manga curta e calça cinza, uma combinação difícil de errar. Henry escolheu uma polo de manga longa e trabalhou um visual quase monocromático, em azul-marinho muito fechado. Nos pés, Federer coordenou o tênis preto com a parte superior, enquanto Henry usou o branco como ponto de contraste.

the most beautiful & romantic train ride I’ve ever been on, and for less than $100. here are all the details 👇🏼

the gorgeous Belle Époque train in Switzerland runs from Montreux to Gstaad and Zweisimmen (and back), offering views of the Swiss countryside. The journey takes about 2h each way.

this train ride has been on my bucket list for the longest time, and I was so happy we got to experience it. 🥹

in addition to the normal daily trips, there are also regular special trips you can book: the chocolate train (with visits to both a cheese and a chocolate factory, and tastings of both!) and the cheese train (with cheese demonstration + fondue lunch).

we ended up booking our tickets for one of the day/times of the chocolate train without knowing, but the experience was sold out by the time we got there and asked. We still got to ride the train like everyone else, except we didn’t go to the cheese and chocolate stops. Next time I definitely want to try that!

💰what’s the price?

A first class ticket to the Belle Epoque train costs CHF 59 per person, plus an additional CHF 10 for seat assignment (about $70 + $12 USD). Second class ticket is a bit cheaper, CHF 34, but doesn’t look like the video above - although it’s beautiful, too.

🍲 is food available?

We had read that there was no food on the train, so we asked our hotel to pack a picnic basket for us since we were going to spend 4 hours on the train (return trip). but once the train departed, we were handed a menu of drinks & snacks.

we ordered some sweets and extra coffee to complement our picnic, and later on, some champagne too! I’ve heard from others that they didn’t get a menu when they went, so I’m not sure if the food/drinks are only available on certain days/times, or if you have to go find a waiter if they don’t come to you.

If this Switzerland train ride wasn’t on your bucket list, I hope I convinced you to add it!

Remote Work Makes Workers Happier and More Likely to Stick Around:

A new study of 7,704 workers , published recently in the journal Frontiers of Psychology, showed that fully-remote workers had the highest levels of well-being, while those who were 100% in the office ranked lowest. 

In the words of the study’s authors, in a statement to Fortune: “Our findings challenge the idea that simply bringing people back into a building will automatically make them more engaged, connected, or likely to stay.”

“The mistake is treating physical presence as the outcome rather than asking what organizations are trying to accomplish through it. If the goal is collaboration, mentoring, innovation, relationship-building, or organizational culture, then employers should design experiences that actually produce those outcomes.”

The study further found that fully-remote workers were more likely to stick around – their higher levels of well-being strongly correlated with longer retention periods and less voluntary turnover. 

RWN’s Take 

The study’s findings undermine many of the core arguments of return-to-office (RTO) advocates like Elon Musk or Jamie Dimon, who hold that remote work leads to disconnected, unproductive employees.

Instead, the research suggests that the pressures of being forced into a physical office damages an employee’s sense of autonomy and well-being, without any measurable productivity gains in return. 

Another common criticism of remote work is that it makes it harder to build a consistent company culture. The study addresses this issue, too, as the paper’s authors suggest that remote work can actually lead to slightly higher levels of positive engagement with their peers and colleagues. The key is to be intentional and consistent, encouraging managers to be diligent about 1:1 check-ins and other rituals around open communication.

Ultimately, the paper gives a lot of backing to something that many remote work-first teams already know: Working remotely can make for happier, more productive, and more engaged teams, as long as you’re using the right tools in the right ways.

Al primo provino mi sono presentato vestito da donna.

É un ragazzo abituato a essere corpo e non persona. 
É un ragazzo mosso dal vuoto, dalla superficialità, dal niente. 
Gioia è un’insegnante di francese. 
É un donna colta che però ha conosciuto la vita solo sui libri.
É una creatura fragile e sola.

Ecco queste due persone si incontrano.

Francesco, trovarmi in scena con te mi fa sentire a casa.

Japanese wrestlers before and after their matches 🫯

At a recent @sukeban_world event in Los Angeles, photographer @ramonadai captured the wrestlers at two very different moments: just before entering the ring and immediately after the match.

The contrast tells the story. On one side, meticulously constructed characters, bold makeup and immaculate styling. On the other, sweat, smudged faces and the physical exhaustion left behind by the performance. The series was published by @welcome.jpeg in July 2026.

Founded in 2023, Sukeban merges Japanese women’s professional wrestling with fashion, anime and performance, drawing its name from the rebellious Japanese girl-gang subculture that emerged in the 1960s and ’70s.

These before-and-after portraits reveal the two realities behind the spectacle: the fantasy of the character and the person who steps out of the ring once the performance is over.

William Josephs Radford (@josephsradford) photographed his grief instead of trying to explain it.

After losing his father in 2024, the British-Spanish photographer began creating a deeply personal body of work exploring memory, absence, and grief.

Radford used experimental in-camera techniques, such as ghosting, light painting, lens masking, and the deliberate use of distorted optics, to recreate the instability of memory during the final months of his father’s life.

At the heart of his work is the idea of grief as something physical. Rather than documenting loss literally, Radford transforms it into blur, visual noise, fading forms, and fragmented images: visual traces of someone who is no longer there.

Hiroshi Nagai’s (@hiroshipenguinjoe) paintings of empty swimming pools, palm trees and endless blue skies became iconic images of Japanese pop culture, even though many of the places he depicted never actually existed.

After travelling through the US in 1973 and visiting Guam the following year, Nagai became fascinated by American landscapes, tropical scenery and soul music. He began combining buildings, pools and landscapes from travel brochures, photographs and architecture books to create imaginary places, often joking that he was simply “planting palm trees everywhere.”

His most famous connection to Japanese city pop came through Eiichi Ohtaki’s 1981 album A Long Vacation. Nagai had originally used the title for an illustrated book, and Ohtaki later developed the idea into an album featuring one of Nagai’s paintings as its cover. The image had actually been created from photographs supplied for a winery advertisement. The album became hugely popular, with some fans even asking if they could buy only the cover to hang on their walls.

Nagai was remarkably fast, sometimes producing more than ten paintings a month. His experience creating television scenery helped him develop a technique based on simple silhouettes, shadows and highlights. Although his style was widely copied, his work gained renewed international attention decades later through the global revival of Japanese city pop.

Love to football, but more love to the time we made  @munchinwithmaddie_ s pull-apart football bread 🏈 

INGREDIENTS
• 1 pound pizza dough, cut into 30-32 pieces
• Low-moisture mozzarella cheese, cut into 1-inch pieces (32 total)
• Pepperoni
• 1 large egg, lightly beaten
• Flaky salt
• 2 tbsp butter, melted
• 1/2 tsp Italian seasoning
 • 1/2 tsp garlic
• Parm
• For serving: Hot honey, marinara sauce, crushed red pepper flakes

Cut the pizza dough and a block of mozzarella into small pieces. Flatten out the pizza dough - if it’s a little sticky, just rub a little olive oil on your hands. Tuck a piece of pepperoni and cheese at the center of the dough. Close the dough around it, pinch it closed and roll into a ball. 

Start arranging into a football shape on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Brush with a beaten egg, and sprinkle with flaky salt. 

Bake at 350ºF until golden brown, about 20 minutes. Then pop it under the broiler for a few minutes to brown the tops. If you see some of the cheese escaping - do not panic. It’s totally fine, it happens. 

Melt the butter, then add the Italian seasoning and garlic, and mix. Brush over the bread. Top with hot honey, red pepper flakes, and grated Parm.

Il 31 luglio hai la consapevolezza che stai andando nella direzione sbagliata, con la persona sbagliata e hai sempre la percezione di stare un passo avanti e che l’altro, stia un passo decisamente indietro.
Eppure ci hanno insegnato che ACCANTO, sia l’unica forma
possibile di amore.
Poi arriva il 31 agosto, i silenzi prendono il posto dei fuochi d’artificio che alla fine hanno un solo scopo, illuminare per un nanosecondo e poi perdersi nel cielo.
L’estate finisce e con lei anche quella parte di te che si è dovuta rimpicciolire per entrare nel cuore di qualcuno, che in fondo, non aveva intenzione di farti spazio davvero.
In fine il 31 settembre, una data che non esiste dove muoiono tutti quei rapporti che pensavano di avere un giorno in più.
Quell’ultima occasione per cui rimandiamo a domani.
Ed allora penso, che stupidi.
State ancora lí a pensare che per tutto ci sia un tempo, che ci sarà un giorno migliore per dire “mi mancava la tua voce”, un momento più giusto per chiedere “resti? Anche se sono un casino?”. 
Un’occasione perfetta per non sentirti piccolo dentro un cuore grande.
Come se l’amore avesse un calendario.
Come se le persone avessero una data di scadenza scritta abbastanza grande da poterla leggere prima di perderle.
Rimandiamo gli abbracci perché “tanto ci vediamo”.
Le telefonate perché “la chiamo domani”.
Le parole perché “prima o poi glielo dirò”.
E intanto collezioniamo cose non dette come quando riempiamo il carrello di Amazon e alla fine non ordiniamo nulla.
Ma il 31 settembre non arriverà.
Non arriverà quel giorno in più che pensavi di avere.
Non arriverà l’occasione perfetta.
Non arriverà qualcuno a restituirti tutte le volte in cui avresti potuto essere felice e hai scelto di aspettare.
Perciò amate nel tempo presente.
E soprattutto scegliete qualcuno che vi cammini ACCANTO.
Non davanti da doverlo rincorrere.
Non dietro da doverlo aspettare.
Accanto. 🪢

If you’re new here, hi! I’m Vanessa 🤍 I’m currently expecting our double rainbow baby after two years of trying and back-to-back miscarriages. 🌈🌈

After my losses, I wanted to dig deeper into my health before trying to conceive again. I’ve been staying on top of my bloodwork since 2025 and working closely with my doctors to understand what we could look at and optimize.

I’m not a doctor, and this series isn’t medical advice. I’m simply sharing my personal results and what my team of doctors chose to investigate based on my history.

One of the questions I get asked most often is: “What did you do differently this time?”

There isn’t one simple answer…and I can’t say that anything I did differently is why this pregnancy worked, but I can share what we looked into.

So welcome to my 4-part Pregnancy After Loss Bloodwork Series. 🤍

PART 1: FERRITIN + CBC 🩸

Before conceiving, my ferritin was around 33. My doctor wanted my iron stores higher going into pregnancy and discussed a goal of around 60–80 for me. What surprised me most? My hemoglobin was normal, which meant I wasn’t anemic, even though my iron stores weren’t where my doctor wanted them.

I didn’t understand before this experience that you can have low iron stores while your hemoglobin and CBC still look relatively normal. Despite taking oral iron during pregnancy, my ferritin eventually dropped to 10, and I now need iron infusions. Looking back, I wish I had done the infusion before conceiving—but hindsight is 20/20, and I’ll be doing a separate series all about my ferritin journey.

Part 2: Thyroid + Vitamin D coming next! 🤍

As always, your results and needs may be completely different from mine, so please discuss your own bloodwork with your healthcare provider.

Postpartum with Winston was extremely hard. I was mourning the loss of my grandfather just days after giving birth, seasonal depression was setting in, and my postpartum anxiety was at an all-time high.

Not everyone understood what I was going through or could empathize with the way I was feeling. Irrational thoughts became very real fears, and the weight of other people’s opinions and judgment only made an already difficult season feel heavier. It was around that time that I restarted therapy, something I’ve always believed in and that became such an important outlet for me during that season. Forever a huge advocate for therapy!

But that was my postpartum experience. And looking back, I wish I could tell that version of myself to stop worrying so much about what other people thought.

This time around, I’m trying to be more proactive about taking care of myself before I even get to postpartum. I’m starting therapy again before giving birth, and I’m staying on top of my blood work and physical health so I can go into this next chapter feeling as supported as possible, both mentally and physically. I know I can’t control what my postpartum experience will look like, but I can put the support systems in place now that I know I may need later.

So if you’re in the postpartum trenches right now and it feels like no one quite understands the reasons behind your boundaries, your rules, or the way you’re choosing to navigate this season, do what brings you the most peace. Choose what creates less stress. Less anxiety. More calm. More safety. More space to heal.

You don’t need everyone to understand your postpartum experience. You just need to honour what you need to get through it. 🤍
